name: Phoenix Rebirth #82 — Yemoja, Mother of the Endless Waters
description: She is the origin of waters and the cradle of life. Yemoja, Yoruba mother of rivers and oceans, governs fertility, protection, and nurturing power; in Phoenix form her wings move like tidal currents, carrying the depth of endless seas, sustaining rather than destroying, embodying maternal infinity and the calm strength that endures beyond storm.
